ex.en: Ooh, that cake looks absolutely delicious!
ex.zh: 哦，那個蛋糕看起來太好吃了！

ex.en: Ooh, I love this song. Turn it up!
ex.zh: 哦，我好愛這首歌，開大聲一點！

ex.en: Thick mud oozed between her toes.
ex.zh: 濃稠的泥巴從她的腳趾間滲出來。

ex.en: Sap oozes from the tree when you cut the bark.
ex.zh: 切開樹皮時，樹液會慢慢滲出來。

ex.en: The boat sank into the black ooze at the bottom of the lake.
ex.zh: 船陷進了湖底的黑色軟泥裡。

ex.en: A bit of ooze came out of the cracked pipe.
ex.zh: 破裂的管子滲出了一點黏液。

ex.en: Oops, I forgot to bring my wallet.
"Oops!" she said as the cup slipped from her hand.
ex.zh: 杯子從她手中滑落時，她說：「哎呀！」
